//: MCP servers for SlotSight. See docs/mcp-servers.md for what each one unlocks.
NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE. The one server that needs a key reads it from an
'inputs' prompt, so VS Code stores it in your OS credential manager and it
never touches the repository. See SECURITY.md.

inputs.title: Context7 API key
inputs.description: Optional. Context7 works without a key at a lower rate limit. Get one free at https://context7.com/dashboard

github.//: Issues, PRs, Actions, code search across GitHub. VS Code handles OAuth - no token to store.

microsoft-docs.//: Official Microsoft/Azure documentation and code samples. No auth. Use this instead of recalling Azure API versions.

context7.//: Current, version-accurate library docs: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, Pydantic v2, React 19, Tailwind v4. Beats recalling APIs that changed recently.

azure.//: Live Azure resources: provision, deploy, inspect, price. Auth comes from your `az login` session - no credentials here.

//: OUR OWN SERVER. Exposes the live slot floor to Copilot Chat.
Ask 'which banks are fading?' in chat and it queries the real database
through the SAME analytics functions the REST API uses.
Requires: docker compose up (for the database). See mcp/README.md.
